lines.cyr: Ај, ферман дојде џанам од Стамбола
lines.lat: Aj, ferman dojde džanam od Stambola
lines.en: Oh, a decree came, my dear, from Istanbul,
the town crier walks through the market,
let the sipahis (cavalrymen) gather,
a great war has broken out,
a great war in Muscovy, hey.

lines.cyr: Ај, спаивчето џанам само се посврши
lines.lat: Aj, spaivčeto džanam samo se posvrši
lines.en: Oh, the young sipahi, my dear, only just got engaged,

lines.cyr: во четврток зборот тој ми даде,
lines.lat: vo četvrtok zborot toj mi dade,
lines.en: on Thursday he gave his word,
on Saturday he will hold the wedding,
on Sunday the soldier is to go.

lines.cyr: Ај, спаивчето џанам коња ми ружи
lines.lat: Aj, spaivčeto džanam konja mi ruži
lines.en: Oh, the young sipahi, my dear, is saddling his horse,
the bride stands there silent before him,
and his old mother

lines.cyr: диван стоет дробни солзи ронет, де.
lines.lat: divan stoet drobni solzi ronet, de.
lines.en: stands silent, shedding small tears, hey.

lines.cyr: Ај, го прашала џанам неговата мајка
lines.lat: Aj, go prašala džanam negovata majka
lines.en: Oh, his mother asked him, my dear,
oh young sipahi, you young soldier,

lines.cyr: коња спремаш каде ти ќе одиш?
lines.lat: konja spremaš kade ti ḱe odiš?
lines.en: you ready your horse, where will you go?
To whom will you leave your young bride
and your old mother, hey?

lines.cyr: Ај, ој ти мајко џанам стара мајко,
lines.lat: Aj, oj ti majko džanam stara majko,
lines.en: Oh, you mother, my dear, old mother,

lines.cyr: дел' ме прашаш право ќе ти кажам,
lines.lat: del' me prašaš pravo ḱe ti kažam,
lines.en: since you ask me I will tell you straight,

lines.cyr: тебе мајко нема да те лажам:
lines.lat: tebe majko nema da te lažam:
lines.en: I will not lie to you, mother:
a decree came from Istanbul,
the town crier walks through the market,
let the sipahis gather.
A great war has broken out,
a great war in Muscovy, hey.
